question: Should Gitcrawl accept the v5 sync_attempt_failures SQLite ledger and the new sync-failures/coverage JSON contract as the supported solution for failed hydration tracking?
rationale: The implementation appears narrow and proof-backed, but durable schema versions and agent-facing JSON fields are compatibility commitments that automation should not decide alone.

options.title: Approve the v5 ledger contract
options.body: Accept the schemaVersion 5 migration plus the new read-only CLI and coverage JSON fields, then merge after normal checks remain green.

options.title: Request a compatibility adjustment
options.body: Ask for a specific upgrade guard, documentation note, or JSON contract tweak before the schema ships.

options.title: Defer the durable ledger
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers do not want a persistent failure-ledger table in the next release.

recommendation.title: Approve the v5 ledger contract
recommendation.body: Accept the schemaVersion 5 migration plus the new read-only CLI and coverage JSON fields, then merge after normal checks remain green.
